purpose: Size C_rad generator-spread systematic as half-difference vs max(half-difference/smoothed, k*u_diff) statistical floor; prospective only, no budget/release/response/plot/C_rad-table file modified.

recommendation.formula: c_rad_gen_rel = max(0.5*GaussSmooth_pTrow(|rel|), u_diff); rel=(C_rad_rapgap31-C_rad_djangoh14)/C_rad_djangoh14 (matched xFGen<0, EMPZ>45); u_diff=sqrt(u_rel_dj^2+u_rel_rg^2) from shipped relative_stat_unc columns; kernel exp(-0.5*Delta^2), sigma=1.0 pT-bin, edge-truncated renormalized per (charge,cell,z) 5-point pT row
recommendation.rationale: House-smoothed envelope (phi_h_gauss_rel/ibu_model convention) with B1-style max() difference-noise floor; k=1.0 binding is algebraically the 2-sigma noise-consistency rule (binds exactly the 152/153 NOISE_CONSISTENT bins); never under-claims in the 18 dangerous bins; k=1.5 rejected (inflates h- max to 13.68%, above the raw measured max 9.16%).
recommendation.double_count_audit: max() selects between model reading and resolution reading of one measurement (no additive fold); sqrt(term^2+(k*floor)^2) would fold table MC-stat additively into the model envelope - the rejected violation.
recommendation.prior_dependence: no - rel and relative_stat_unc are generator-level quantities from the C_rad MC tables; no unfolding prior, response, or IBU iterate enters; unlike the B1 response-bootstrap floor.
recommendation.regime_B_bookkeeping: When c_rad_applied=true: retire the floor, model term reverts to un-floored V3, applied-table per-bin relative_stat_unc becomes its own separate statistical component; keeping max(...,k*u_diff) then would double-count u_dj in every floor-binding bin.

djangoh14.relative_stat_unc: per-bin relative stat unc on C_rad (= C_rad_stat_unc/C_rad; combined rad+nonrad legs, u_rel(C)=sqrt(u_rel_nonrad^2+u_rel_rad^2))
djangoh14.C_rad_stat_unc: absolute per-bin stat unc on C_rad

stat_fields_used.rapgap31: same two columns of the rapgap CSV

field_provenance.per_leg_note: Separate u(sigma_rad)/u(sigma_nonrad) columns are absent, but the propagated combined per-bin u(C_rad) is shipped as C_rad_stat_unc/relative_stat_unc and is designated errors/per_bin in the co-located validation JSONs; used directly, no Poisson sqrt(N) substitution.

formulas.u_diff: sqrt(u_rel_dj^2 + u_rel_rg^2), u_rel = relative_stat_unc of each generator
formulas.V3: 0.5*GaussSmooth_pTrow(|rel|), kernel exp(-0.5*Delta^2), sigma=1.0 pT-bin, edge-truncated renormalized within each (charge,cell,z) 5-point pT row
